profile.headline: Excelling Your Software to Your Needs
profile.summary: Experienced Contract Web Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Debugging Code, PHP, Engineering, C++, and Microsoft Office. Strong engineering professional with a Master’s Degree focused in Computer Software Engineering from California State University-Northridge.

positions.title: Contract Web Developer
positions.description:
Giverne of Beverly Hills is a new company looking to brand their own line of clothing and accessories.
	Designed and developed a fully customize e-commerce website, including front-end, back-end, and database.
	Simplified payment processing by using APIs for PayPal and Authorize.net, which eliminated the need for PCI compliance.
	Technologies used: MySQL, jQuery, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML, PHP

positions.title: Contract Web Developer
positions.description:
S T E R O B Productions, LLC is a new company looking to break into the world of pornographic content delivery, ranging from Twitter feeds to cam shows.
	Designed and developed content delivery subscription service portal, front-end, back-end, and database.
	Implemented payment processing API from GT Bill for subscription based service.
	Technologies used: MySQL, jQuery, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML, PHP

company.name: S T E R O B Productions, LLC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ACCO Engineered Systems is a construction company that specializes in HVAC, electrical, control systems, and plumbing. With over 3300 employees and over $1 billion in revenue, ACCO is the industry leader on the west coast.
	Slashed time spent on payroll by designing, implementing, and maintaining multiple time sheet systems for office, field, and shop employees. Served as developer on the office and field time sheet systems and served as project manager, business analyst, and developer on 3 different shop time sheet systems.
	Redesigned database structure for better performance and database integrity. Designed a new database schema to be used as the corporate hub of data.
	Push for source control improvement as the core proponent and main implementer of Github, moving the company away from the antiquated SVN. Also, served as the trainer for Github.
	Technologies used: MySQL, JavaScript, Sencha Framework, Perl, PHP, AJAX, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
ADVANCED Motion Controls is a manufacturing company that designs, produces, and service electrical amplifiers and servo drives used in motion controls. These products are used in many industries, including medical, robotics, and production.
	Redesigned the Design for Manufacturing workflow into a web application to automate the process flow and add accountability via authentication. This provided a platform for the project managers to keep records of the design process and follow up as necessary.
	Greatly reduced hours spent on daily and year-end inventory for manufacturing pacts by developing Windows applications to automate menial tasks, such as part code verification, label printing, and part tracking. These applications communicated with the third-party printer through DYMO’s API.
	Improved user experience by redesigning internal applications using newer technologies.
	Technologies used: MySQL, MSSQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, PHP, ASP.net, C#, .NET 4.5, jQuery, AJAX, REST
